content.summary: Product manager with 8 years of experience building B2B workflow tools, translating customer research into clear roadmaps, and delivering measurable adoption outcomes.

experience.title: Senior Product Manager
bullets: Led the roadmap for a workflow platform used by 14,000 monthly active business users.
Launched role-based automation that reduced average approval time by 47%.
Established a discovery cadence with 60 customer interviews per quarter, increasing feature adoption by 26%.

experience.title: Product Manager
bullets: Prioritized merchant tooling across payments and inventory workflows, improving weekly retention by 18%.
Partnered with engineering to cut high-priority defect resolution time from 9 days to 3 days.
